description: This horizontal bar chart, titled “Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models,” illustrates the number of tasks (# tasks) associated with each language family, with the categories listed along the vertical axis and the number of tasks along the horizontal axis, which is labeled “# tasks” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with tick marks at intervals of 10. The bars are sorted in descending order from top to bottom based on their length. The IE-Slavic family has the longest bar, extending to approximately 79 tasks, colored light blue. The IE-Romance family follows with a dark blue bar reaching approximately 47 tasks. The IE-Germanic family, shown in light green, has a bar of approximately 44 tasks. The Uralic family, in green, has a bar of approximately 20 tasks. The IE-Baltic family, in pink, reaches approximately 17 tasks. The IE-other family, in red, has a bar of approximately 15 tasks. The IE-Indic family, in orange, reaches approximately 10 tasks. The Semitic family, in orange, has a bar of approximately 9 tasks. The Turkic family, in light purple, has a bar of approximately 5 tasks. The Basque family, in dark purple, has the shortest bar, reaching approximately 4 tasks. All bars are solid-colored and unannotated, with no visual emphasis or grouping.
